Travel Notice for Companion Animals

Travelers need to check animal age and crate size before booking with Aurelia Skyways.

For reptile travel, the minimum age is 11 weeks, and younger animals are not accepted for transport. Please review health papers and feeding plans before arrival so the journey starts without delay.

For cat travel, the crate must have a longest side of 61 cm, and the crate must be secure, clean, and fit the animal without crowding. Safety takes priority over speed on every route, and clear checks at the desk help protect pets and staff alike.

Please bring your documents and carrier details to the Companion Animal Travel Desk before departure. Communications Aide, Companion Animal Travel Desk
